system_thesis_interpretation: D0 preserves the organism-level thesis as an explicit but deliberately nonexecuting architecture. The eventual organism is still ordinary public action/outcome experience -> target-independent recurrent DREAM search for local connections -> later public support or contradiction -> deterministic SLEEP compilation -> cumulative per-life LoRA transport -> one-atom reads -> recurrent, goal-conditioned THINK path construction -> later action, with a separately reserved on-policy edge by which those actions could change later evidence and repeat the loop. That is faithful to the thesis because it keeps the organs and their credit boundaries distinct: DREAM broadens local connectivity but cannot declare truth; SLEEP admits and re-expresses supported atoms but cannot discover; the LoRA is lossy parametric transport rather than a literal graph; THINK constructs a temporary cited path rather than copying a stored plan; and only ordinary outcomes can be evidence. It also honestly limits scope: D0 instantiates a deterministic CPU world, public contracts, lifecycle and snapshot references, a fixture-only compiler and reader, exact controllers, estimators, ledgers, and falsifiers. It makes no THINK or DREAM model call, trains or reads no LoRA, runs no scientific arm, and cannot exercise the closed action--experience flywheel. Thus D0 can preserve and make falsifiable the organism design without providing evidence that any cognitive organ, substrate, or complete organism works.
graph_delta_interpretation: Operationally, the fixed scripted source policy sends typed actions into the finite CPU world, which emits canonical public event bytes. Within a world, hidden mappings remain inside the environment and isolated scorer; across arms, each assigned arm receives the same sealed source bytes. At a future sealed cut, only eligible public replay slots could enter DREAM. DREAM could traverse replay and one returned prior-memory atom in bounded working state, then submit one local subject--relation--object proposal with public-root slots, supported-parent slots, and a preregistered future prediction. The lifecycle service, not DREAM, resolves those slots to canonical identities, appends proposal/status/revision records, deduplicates intervention-cluster roots, applies relation-specific fit, prediction, negative, and separating-panel rules, rejects alias-hidden cycles and taint, and allows later evidence to change status only in a later immutable snapshot. SLEEP then reads only supported, nonrevoked canonical atoms from that sealed cut, deterministically sorts/deduplicates and old/new-mixes them, and emits four one-edge views. Those declarative objects remain explicit audit state: public events, proposals, statuses, canonical atoms, provenance roots, views, catalogs, manifests, and snapshots. A future text/graph/native backend or recognition-assisted LoRA backend may compute differently behind the common reader, but cognition gets only one canonical FOUND atom or NOT_FOUND. A future THINK call keeps temporary state only: current public goal/state, at most four returned-atom slots, a bounded cited path, public outcome slots, repeat state, and budgets. It uses generic anchor-only local reads to update or backtrack a goal-directed path and releases at most one typed action. The per-life LoRA is a third state class: cumulative psi_l rebuilt from theta_0 from the same frozen semantic atom set, isolated per life, not inspectable as an explicit graph, and entirely dormant in D0. Thinker attempts and fixed-deck evaluation outcomes never become later DREAM evidence: current-item outcomes may alter temporary replanning, while evaluation writes are denied. Only after a new on-policy authorization could policy-selected actions create ordinary public source outcomes eligible for a later sealed replay/support/SLEEP cycle; even then the attempt trace itself is not evidence, and any declassified operation trace belongs to separately authorized outer phi training. Snapshot edges seal every causal input and audit object; scoring receives evaluation outcomes one-way and cannot write back. Authority edges make N01--N08 and N13 reachable only after exact D0 ratification and keep N09--N12, model, GPU, LoRA, scientific, and claim transitions unreachable.
loop_delta_interpretation: Only L01 and L02 can become active under this change, and only after exact-byte human ratification. L01 is a bounded implement-test-seal-repair loop over local deterministic CPU reference components; it stops on scope mismatch, missing authority, any remote/model/GPU/LoRA dependency, invariant failure, completion, or CPU-budget exhaustion, and green results stop at D0. L02 deterministically generates/replays the target-blind and outcome-blind fixed source deck over reset specimens, writes canonical events, and seals complete-event prefixes at 0.5C, 0.75C, 1C, 1.5C, and 2C; invalid actions, terminal outcomes, a frozen cut, invariant failure, or 100000 rejected proposals stop rather than trigger relaxation or performance-based replacement. L03 reserves recurrent THINK: greedy, one canonical operation per turn, at most one world action, bounded query/operation/action/token budgets, backtracking on ordinary current-item outcomes, and termination on success, irreversible failure, defer/stop, malformed or multi-operation output, cap exhaustion, or a second blocked repeat. L04 reserves recurrent DREAM as breadth-like local exploration, not whole-plan generation: four preallocated independent samples, temperature 0.7/top-p 0.9, no replacement for malformed samples, bounded traversal, and at most one proposal/prediction per sample; sample multiplicity is search effort, never evidentiary weight. L05 separates deterministic SLEEP compilation from future adapter transport and stops D0 after fixture compilation. L06 reserves a staged fixed-deck scientific assay with explicit failure gates and no evaluation writes. L07 alone reserves the full memory -> information-seeking action -> ordinary evidence -> later DREAM/support/SLEEP -> later memory loop, but it is inactive and separately requires on_policy=true, new estimands, visibility review, safety boundaries, and human authority. The scale claim is correspondingly limited: D0 tests 64 fixed twin pairs and deterministic reference performance; the later first assay has only 13 reusable mappings and an imposed 8192-token working budget, so neither repetition nor one post-working-window checkpoint is a developmental curve. Multi-sector novelty, at least three post-native-context points, A4, learned phi, cadence, and external validation remain later loops rather than implicit promotions.
claim_delta_interpretation: The only D0-positive claims are protocol-conformance and CPU-instrument statements. Passing reference tests could show that the bound CPU bytes implement the declared world, lifecycle, compiler, visibility, controller, estimator, durability, resource, and report-language contracts, and that the uncurated generator has registered exact-controller headroom and shortcut resistance. It would not show that DREAM finds true connections, THINK reconstructs them with a model, LoRA retains action value, or the organism improves behavior. A future fixed-deck behavioral result, if separately authorized and confirmed, is credited first to the complete frozen protocol. DREAM earns discovery credit only for target-independent proposals later supported by independent ordinary public evidence; the lifecycle earns admission/status credit; SLEEP earns deterministic transformation credit; the reader and resolver earn retrieval/composition credit; and LoRA earns recognition-assisted parametric transport credit unless unaided-read and causal interventions support more. Negative outcomes remain useful and stage-specific: an oracle/necessity failure invalidates the instrument, a text failure blocks transport, a LoRA failure is a negative transport result rather than a memory-system failure, a native linked-memory match removes a LoRA moat, binding-control failure removes causal-content attribution, and failed confirmation withdraws the positive claim without deleting cells. D0 and even a later PCFL-13 result cannot support online learning, a self-improving flywheel, policy-improved evidence acquisition, continual or scaling behavior, recurrent-sleep superiority, DREAM necessity, autonomous discovery, A4 durable revision, external validity, LoRA superiority/efficiency, fixed-resource equivalence, a literal graph in weights, learned THINK/DREAM, or general intelligence.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The matrix implements least-authority separation among cognition, noncognitive services, and audit. Future THINK alone sees the canonical current public goal/state, bounded workspace/path/repeat/budgets, and last one-atom return. Future DREAM sees eligible sealed replay, its bounded workspace/repeat/budgets, and one prior-memory return, but no goal, live state channel, target/split, claim status/provenance, candidate metadata, hidden truth, or runtime metadata. The common reader sees a snapshot handle, canonical query, and prior returned IDs internally; it is forbidden goal/current-state/target/scorer access and must hide rank, score, candidate set, counts, latency, truncation, backend identity, and errors from cognition. Support/SLEEP may see public roots and internal lifecycle metadata, but not target goals, hidden truth, workspace text, evaluation outcomes, or dormant selector/shortcut state. The environment and isolated scorer may see hidden mappings or proof truth only for transition enforcement and post-seal audit, never as a cognitive input. D0 has broad read authority only because it constructs synthetic fixtures and exact oracles without invoking cognition; derived_only means it may deterministically construct or validate an artifact but not consume it as a live cognitive signal, while hidden means stage-internal state that must not cross the model-visible boundary. Other lives, prior items, sealed evaluation outcomes, caches, retries, audit receipts, and provider state are denied across cognition and per-life memory. Prompts and schemas are visible only where their interface requires them, and authority is checked by runtime/audit rather than exposed as a model-controlled value. This matrix closes the earlier obvious laundering channels at the reference-interface level, but future scientific implementations must re-establish that the actual backend and runtime obey those channels.
acceptance_test_interpretation: AT01_exact_bundle_and_scope_binding checks schema/hash/context/authority integrity before implementation, although the unbound file manifest and CPU cap noted below limit its advertised exactness. AT02_D0_capability_firewall is the decisive executable proof that D0 cannot reach models, networks, weights, adapters, GPU, scientific cells, claims, or promotion paths. AT03_world_twin_determinism_and_marginals checks generator reproducibility, pre-intervention public collision, paired hidden reassignment, marginal matching, namespace independence, and suffix noninterference; it validates the twin instrument, not cognitive use. AT04_target_source_chronology_and_minimality checks target uniqueness, six-action necessity, source/target nonmatch, early/recent distinct roots, A4 exclusion, and outcome-blind rejection; it establishes structural need for construction, not that an agent constructs. AT05_exact_Bayes_and_no_memory_controller validates the full-family and quotient dynamic programs as the exact no-lifetime reference by policy/value, Bellman, mass, symmetry, tie, size, and visibility equivalence. AT06_exact_memory_headroom_necessity_and_shortcuts measures uncurated instrument headroom and the registered memory-necessity/bad-assignment/shortcut formulas; its conclusion concerns exact declarative memory in the CPU world, not DREAM or LoRA. AT07_canonical_schema_parser_and_visibility makes byte forms, one-operation semantics, copy origins, and all visibility cells mechanically reject malformed or hidden inputs. AT08_goal_query_candidate_reader_noninterference perturbs collision/query/catalog/backend surfaces to validate the designed one-atom channel, but D0 fixtures cannot by themselves prove a later model-backed implementation has no additional side channel. AT09_semantic_support_identity_and_provenance property-tests canonical atom identity, append-only status, root equivalence, claim-specific chronology and contrasts, aliases, valid diamonds, cycles, taint, and snapshot-local support. AT10_sleep_compiler_one_edge_and_direct_closure tests deterministic admission and four one-edge views while excluding status, proof, provenance, targets, terminal actions, plans, and direct solution closure; it establishes compiler behavior only. AT11_snapshot_resume_repeat_and_isolation tests causal-cut immutability, call-state recovery, indeterminate non-regeneration, budget consumption, repeat visibility, quarantine, write denial, and cross-life/item isolation. AT12_constructive_trace_causal_faithfulness validates the future credit checker with pre-decision masking, twin substitution, redundant-path cuts, and separation of behavioral success from constructive credit; scripted traces validate the assay, not an actual resolver. AT13_binding_control_and_assignment_invariants distinguishes S-life whole-pipeline corruption, S-bind fixed-corpus binding derangement, and authentic twin cross-assignment while preserving each registered invariant; it does not estimate their future model effects. AT14_split_estimator_multiplicity_and_failures executes the split, pair aggregation, nested seed, zero-valued failure, exact sign-flip, Romano--Wolf, Holm, noninferiority, fixed-16, reserve, and bootstrap rules before outcomes. AT15_resource_ledger_and_baseline_manifest verifies complete unequal-resource accounting and the dormant paper roster without implying fixed-memory, fixed-compute, efficiency, or actual baseline performance. AT16_CPU_performance_budget checks local CPU practicality, bit reproducibility, isolation, and the five-minute simulator bound, but its full-suite cap remains externally unspecified. AT17_claim_linter_and_negative_decisions verifies that protocol conformance, bounded future positives, negative dispositions, required qualifiers, and organ/substrate credit cannot be rewritten into forbidden headlines. AT18_fresh_review_and_new_authority_before_science tests the final nonpromotion boundary: fresh reviewer rejection controls, the advocate cannot override it, repairs are rebound and rereviewed, and green D0 evidence still cannot authorize model, LoRA, GPU, DEV, calibration, confirmation, or claims.
assumptions: The change.json is the controlling delta when an older context note conflicts with it; older notes supply lineage and constraints, not independent authority.
Byte-identical source experience means identical across memory arms within a world/twin assignment, not identical outcome bytes between counterfactual twins after an action touches a swapped mapping.
A DREAM citation of a replay or parent slot is resolved by noncognitive lifecycle code; cognition does not receive the forbidden internal claim-status, support-count, or provenance metadata.
D0 exact-memory and scripted-resolver runs are deterministic reference fixtures and do not count as model-backed scientific arms.

Within-item public outcomes may update temporary THINK state, but only ordinary outcomes admitted by a separately authorized source/on-policy lifecycle may become durable evidence; fixed-deck evaluation outcomes never do.
The one-atom return contains the canonical semantic atom only, with no claim handle, status, provenance, confidence, rank, score, count, backend, timing, or failure metadata.
The future per-life adapter is rebuilt cumulatively from theta_0 at each authorized cut and is reset for each distinct life; no optimizer, cache, or adapter state crosses lives.
Passing a D0 property test validates the reference test mechanism and contract at synthetic scale, not the behavior of a later 32B/7B model system.

ambiguities.question: Which exact source files, test files, commands, and runtime entry points constitute the 'named D0 CPU files' that ratification releases?
ambiguities.impact: The proposal defines component categories but contains no file/entrypoint manifest, so AT01 and AT02 cannot mechanically distinguish an in-scope D0 edit from an implementation-convenience expansion solely from these bytes.

ambiguities.question: What exact wall-time, core, memory, process, and total CPU budget is the separately declared pre-GPU budget referenced by L01 and AT16?
ambiguities.impact: The 1000-step five-minute bound is exact, but the full oracle/property-suite stop condition and ratified resource scope are not executable without the missing budget declaration.

ambiguities.question: Are the future THINK per-decision limits exactly four queries and eight resolver operations from note 46, and what is the per-sample DREAM operation budget beyond four preallocated samples and token limits?
ambiguities.impact: L03 and L04 refer to remaining operation/query/sample budgets without binding all numeric values, so scripted trace termination, resource ledgers, and later model-call authority could diverge.

ambiguities.question: Which hash-bound golden token-count fixtures define complete-event cuts at C=8192 in D0, and may D0 execute the pinned tokenizer solely for conformance despite the no-tokenizer scientific-use boundary?
ambiguities.impact: Source chronology and early/recent support depend on exact token_end values, but the listed prompt/context bytes do not include a golden token-count corpus and the authority language distinguishes neither tokenizer conformance use nor loading clearly.

ambiguities.question: Does S-bind preserve four compiler views, as the proposal graph and AT10 require, or six view counts, as note 47 section 10 states?
ambiguities.impact: The inconsistency changes corpus cardinality, binding-control invariants, training-envelope accounting, and the exact meaning of AT13; the new graph strongly suggests four, but exact human ratification should resolve the stale six-view wording.

ambiguities.question: Are hidden and derived_only formal enforcement modes or explanatory labels, especially where DREAM sees replay derived from public outcomes and the reader derives a return from internal metadata?
ambiguities.impact: The reasons imply a coherent boundary, but without operational definitions an implementation could confuse stage-internal visibility with model-visible visibility or allow a derived artifact to become a cognitive signal.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The bundle is exact about capability prohibitions and scientific nonpromotion, but it is not yet exact enough to support AT01's claim that the complete D0 implementation scope is byte-bound.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: N16 refers to named D0 CPU files, L01 stops at a separately declared CPU budget, and AT16 invokes that budget, yet neither an allowed file/entrypoint manifest nor the full CPU resource cap appears in the proposal or context map. Human ratification of these bytes would therefore bind architectural categories but leave two implementation-scope dimensions external.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Before treating AT01 as passed or releasing implementation, bind the permitted D0 file/entrypoint/command manifest and exact CPU resource budget in a hash-bound human decision or a revised proposal, then revalidate the capability graph against those bytes.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: AT08's falsification language is too broad if read as proving that future substrate channels cannot launder an answer.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: D0 can exhaustively test canonical CPU catalogs, scripted backends, return serialization, and timing/error fixtures, but it cannot load or execute the later text, native, generative, or LoRA model-backed implementations. A future backend can introduce hidden target conditioning, cache coupling, tokenization behavior, or provider/runtime leakage while still conforming to a shallow fixture.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Interpret D0 as validating the reference noninterference contract only, and require the later D2/G-TEXT/G-CAL authorization and independent review to rerun equivalent black-box and process-level noninterference tests on the exact scientific backends before any model outcome is interpreted.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: AT12 and AT13 make the future causal-credit and binding interventions executable as CPU reference checkers, but their D0 outputs cannot establish causal constructive use or binding dependence by the future organism.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Scripted traces are constructed to change under masking or twin substitution, and synthetic corpora are constructed to satisfy derangement invariants. Those tests are necessary evidence that the measurement code behaves as intended; they contain no autonomous resolver, DREAM proposal process, or trained substrate whose behavior could be attributed.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Keep their D0 conclusion explicitly at protocol-conformance level and require separately authorized model-backed masked/twin forks and S-life/S-bind/T-swap outcomes before awarding resolver, DREAM, corpus-content, or LoRA credit.
